_about: Provenance of every reconstructed value, keyed by file and then by JSON pointer. 'first-party' = stated in a file in sources/ (cite it). 'forced-choice' = the sources record no value or decision, but a filing would have had to state one; give the value a cautious filer would declare and say why. 'placeholder' = not public; the value exists only so the record validates and must never be used in a predicate. Unlisted pointers are structural (ids, record types, schema version, labels). In this template every value is invented (Lab X), so the entries below only show the format.

_case_wide.unit_of_filing: forced-choice: one Intent and one Closeout for the single evaluation run

intent_A.json./run_kind: first-party: <source file, date>: '<quoted sentence that states it>'
intent_A.json./filed_at: forced-choice: 5 days before the start (the minimum for intake review is 3)
intent_A.json./egress_topology/permitted_paths/0: first-party: <source>: the allowlist proxy and its GET-only rule

closeout_A.json./security_events/0: first-party: <source>: the egress, when it happened and when it was detected
closeout_A.json./third_party_notifications/0: first-party: <source>: who was told, when and how

notice_N1.json./filed_at: forced-choice: within the 72-hour notice window; the sources do not date the notice
